summary: Extended the canonical preparation contracts for multi-currency facts per PH-308 §9A, without implementing business write paths or changing applied migrations. Added CurrencyCode (ISO 4217 pattern), OriginalCents and OriginalSignedCents to contract-bundle; made Money.currency use CurrencyCode while legacy CNY facts remain valid; added optional currency, original_*_cents and fx_rate_ref fields to the target entities (ContractLine, Settlement, OpenItem, RevenueRecognition, RevenueAdjustment, TaxQualification, CashTransaction, BankCharge, Refund, BankReturn, Invoice, InvoiceLine, InvoiceAllocation, InvoiceReversal); extended the corresponding write DTOs and the invoicing.invoice.record/v1 payload with the same optional fields. The README freezes the compatibility and migration policy: legacy *_CnyCents fields remain the CNY book-currency display/equality values, a missing currency is interpreted as CNY, non-CNY facts store original-currency minor units and a CNY-derived book amount consistently, non-CNY writes must be rejected by the service until PH-321, and implementation uses additive nullable->CNY-backfill->non-null migrations without recomputing historical amounts. The extension-freeze canonical_sha256 entries for the four modified canonical files were synchronized so validate_contracts.py passes; check_contract_cases.py still passes its 19 positive/37 rejected examples. A cross-whitelist disclosure is recorded because BASE PH-324 allowed_paths does not include promotion-draft/extension-freeze.json or project/specs/PH-324.md; the Lead authorized this and a PH-328 planning PR will add them, so this branch must be rebased to that corrected BASE before final verification/merge.

deviations: Cross-whitelist (Lead-authorized): BASE PH-324 allowed_paths only contains docs/v1.0-development/contracts/*, but a correct canonical extension requires synchronizing docs/v1.0-development/promotion-draft/extension-freeze.json (the validator asserts the frozen canonical hashes). I updated that file as authorized and disclosed it here; the PH-328 planning PR will add the path (and project/specs/PH-324.md) to the task contract, after which this branch must be rebased to the corrected BASE and verify-change re-run.

Canonical versioning: the extension is additive/backward-compatible (new optional fields; legacy CNY documents still validate), so no breaking canonical version bump was made; the freeze canonical hashes were updated as the contract process requires and the README documents the compatibility/migration policy.

No business write side: services, Django models, migrations and runtime multi-currency behavior are explicitly out of scope; non-CNY writes must be rejected until PH-321, and the schema pass does not claim runtime support.

The extension keeps CNY as the book currency: when currency != CNY the legacy *_cents fields carry the CNY book equivalent while original_*_cents carry the original-currency minor units; the contract requires the service to derive both consistently and forbids double-write inconsistency.
